annotations.text:
CRU-038 — the scope axis.
Household-scoped: pets, feeds, members, alert preferences.
Personal, spans households: account, appearance, the notification inbox.
The alert toggles are on the wrong side of that line today.

Artboard 3 is the first place in the app where owner and contributor look different. Values still show; only the chevron and the tap go.

People is one row. Roles, invites and Leave household are already built on the Members screen and stay there.
Artboard 4 is the screen as it is built today, moved and re-titled. Five toggles across three sections, and it already names the household. Only the Everywhere row is new.
